notes.title: [IMPROVEMENTS] Corrections
notes.content:
Dear players,

Several corrections have been made to the game and we hope that they will improve your experience with Lyla and Henri.

- Concerning the detention slip Puzzle: the division of the pieces is optimized for a 1080p resolution.

- “An network error occurred”: This message can occur if the connection is too slow or nonexistent. If players have a good connection, the error message should not appear.

- The medicines minigame: the issue that was causing the game to crash has been resolved.

- “The error is related to the collapse of the DLL libcocos2d.dll": The needed DLL file is missing. This is a quite common error in games that use cocos2d. To resolve the issue, download the missing file. Here is the provided download link: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?id=48145

Enjoy!
